column1: # Remote lab link profiles. One line per profile, whitespace separated.
#   rtt_ms     round-trip time. The wan container adds half of it in each
#   jitter_ms  round-trip jitter (+/-). Half of it in each direction, uniform.
#   loss_pct   random packet loss, applied in EACH direction.
#   down_mbit  rate toward the client (the NAS uplink). 0 = no limit.
#   up_mbit    rate toward the NAS (the client uplink). 0 = no limit.
# name      rtt_ms  jitter_ms  loss_pct  down_mbit  up_mbit
# abroad without the loss: tells the cost of distance from the cost of loss.
